UC-949.note: after the blackline sheet's body, the heading over a footnote that holds a change ({n} is its number); its paragraphs are marked as the body's (BlacklinePartKind footnote)

UC-950.note: after the blackline sheet's body, the heading over a endnote that holds a change ({n} is its number) (BlacklinePartKind endnote)

UC-951.note: after the blackline sheet's body, the heading over a header on a section's ordinary pages, or one whose pages the host doesn't name (BlacklinePartKind header, slot default)

UC-952.note: after the blackline sheet's body, the heading over a header on a section's first page (slot first_page)

UC-953.note: after the blackline sheet's body, the heading over a header on even pages (slot even_pages)

UC-954.note: after the blackline sheet's body, the heading over a footer on a section's ordinary pages, or one whose pages the host doesn't name (BlacklinePartKind footer, slot default)

UC-955.note: after the blackline sheet's body, the heading over a footer on a section's first page (slot first_page)

UC-956.note: after the blackline sheet's body, the heading over a footer on even pages (slot even_pages)

UC-968.note: after the blackline sheet's body, the heading over a part of a kind this version doesn't know (BlacklinePartKind's string form, or an object with no key this version reads): a newer host's part, which under no heading would read as the body's text

UC-450.note: a header's or footer's heading ({part}, UC-951 to UC-956) with the first section it is on ({n}), only where two headers or footers that changed would otherwise have the same heading; also inside the table line's place (UC-455, in lower case)

UC-451.en: A header or footer couldn't be compared, so changes in it aren't shown. Open both versions in Word to see them.
UC-451.hi: एक हेडर या फ़ुटर की तुलना नहीं की जा सकी, इसलिए उसके बदलाव यहाँ नहीं दिखाए गए हैं। इन्हें देखने के लिए दोनों संस्करण Word में खोलें।
UC-451.note: over the blackline sheet when a header or footer wasn't compared: a header or footer in one version only, one with no one-to-one partner in the other version, or one on a section the other version lacks, so nothing marks their changes (BlacklineNotice header_or_footer_not_compared); shown even when the body changed

UC-452.note: over the blackline sheet in place of UC-391 when the host names the tables whose formatting changed (WordBlackline changed_tables, up to four): {tables} lists each as its place (UC-454 to UC-457), then a colon and what changed (UC-458 to UC-464), the tables apart by semicolons, e.g. 'table 2: borders, shading; table 1 in the header (first page): merged cells'. The item form changed after review round 2 (was 'table 2 (borders, shading)', which gave two brackets in a row after a header's heading)

UC-453.en: Formatting changed in {tables}, and in {n} more.
UC-453.hi: {tables} में, और {n} अन्य में फ़ॉर्मैटिंग बदल गई है।
UC-453.note: as UC-452 when more than four tables changed, or one is in a place this version can't name: the first three, apart by semicolons, then how many more ({n}: the host's count of every changed table, changed_tables_total, minus the three named). Reworded after review round 2 (was '{tables} and {n} more.'), then on the app track's review (was '{tables}; and {n} more.', which read as a typo)

UC-454.note: in the table line (UC-452, UC-453): a table in the document's body, by its number from 1 counting every table in order (TablePlace body)

UC-455.note: in the table line: a table in a header or footer, in the footnotes' form so it can't be read as a body table; {part} is that part's heading (UC-951 to UC-956, with UC-450 where needed) set in lower case in English, e.g. 'table 1 in the header (first page)'. Reworded after review round 2 (was '{part}, table {n}', which in a list read like a body table)

UC-456.note: in the table line: a table in the footnotes; {n} counts the tables of every footnote together (TablePlace footnotes)

UC-457.note: in the table line: a table in the endnotes, counted across every endnote (TablePlace endnotes)

UC-458.note: after a table's colon in the table line: its, a row's or a cell's borders changed (TableFormat borders)

UC-459.note: after a table's colon: shading changed (TableFormat shading)

UC-460.note: after a table's colon: the table's, a column's or a cell's width, or the table's indent, changed (TableFormat widths)

UC-461.note: after a table's colon: the table's alignment on the page, a row's, or a cell's text from top to bottom changed (TableFormat alignment)

UC-462.note: after a table's colon: which cells are merged changed (TableFormat merged_cells)

UC-463.note: after a table's colon: a row's height changed (TableFormat row_height)

UC-464.note: after a table's colon: anything else, such as the table's style, cell margins or a repeated heading row, and a kind this version doesn't know (TableFormat other, unknown)
